name: tools-inbox
description: Inbox triage that never sends: read your own Gmail through your own Composio account, sort it into what needs you, and draft replies for you to send.

composio_api_key.title: Composio API key
composio_api_key.description: Your own key from the Composio dashboard, with your Gmail connected there. Used only for reminders to yourself and to list your connections. Stored in your keychain.
